plain_english_policy: Increase public financial support for early childhood education programs (Head Start).

effects.rationale: Direct state funding implies government delivery or subsidy of childcare services.
Head Start targets low-income families, but the tax burden may fall unevenly (e.g., sales taxes on goods/services used by all households).
Explicit call to increase funding for a welfare-linked program.

evidence_quote: "Increase state funding to expand Head Start programs."
